title: Paneer Butter Masala Recipe
description: This paneer butter masala is a curry lover's dream!! Soft paneer is dunked in a creamy, silky, super flavorful and delicious curry. My easy paneer recipe will help you make the best butter paneer that tastes better than anything from a restaurant. Make this once, I am sure you will never order it in a restaurant. Serve it with butter naan, roti or Basmati rice.

vegetarian.notes: This dish is fully vegetarian as written — no swaps needed.

steps.text: Pour {i14} and mix well. Cook covered on a medium heat until slightly thick, yet flowy. It will thicken upon cooling. (Takes about 10 to 12 mins, keep stirring every 3 to 4 mins). You will see traces of fat on the butter masala when it is ready.

steps.text: Garnish paneer butter masala with {i21} and chopped {i22}. Best served with Basmati Rice, Jeera Rice, Butter Naan, Tandoori Roti or plain parathas.
